//: Pins the .NET SDK feature band for every developer and for CI.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: Directory.Build.props pins LangVersion to 12.0 and warns that a
developer on a newer SDK could commit C# 13+ syntax that compiles locally and fails in
CI. That warning had no enforcement — a teammate with a newer .NET SDK installed
would still build fine on their machine. This file turns that silent divergence into an
immediate, readable error at the first `dotnet` command:
A compatible .NET SDK was not found. Requested: 10.0.100 (rollForward latestFeature)
rollForward=latestFeature accepts ANY 10.0.x SDK at or above 10.0.100 (so 10.0.403 on one
machine and 10.0.100 on another are both fine) and rejects 11.x outright, which is
exactly the boundary .github/workflows/ci.yml enforces with dotnet-version: 10.0.x.
If the team ever moves to .NET 11, three files change in the SAME PR: this one, the
LangVersion in Directory.Build.props, and dotnet-version in ci.yml.
